This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which must be performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Samer Ayad at Sabtia I Cairo, tested at 7/9/02

items:
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category,

CB must be 
isolated completely and grounded on both sides,

Insure that 
the earthing switch must be connected on both sides of the CB.

Safety fence 
(rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area, safety around the work 
place.

Wear safety 
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses

Blower,
 safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses

A complete set of tools, Hydraulic oil if needed, 
 cleaning cloth.

Change the oil after 5 times of an automatic 
 break due to short circuit.
Drain the oil from the CB.
Clean the arc chamber with a new oil.
Refilling the arc chamber with a new oil observe for the oil level.
Lubricate the moving contact of the mechanism operation.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which must be performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft 
initiated by eng. Samer Ayad at Sabtia I Cairo, tested at 7/9/02
A work permit 
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category,
CB must be 
isolated completely and grounded on both sides,
Insure that 
the earthing switch must be connected on both sides of the CB.
Safety fence 
(rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area, safety around the work 
place.
Wear safety 
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses
Control Power disconnected.
Blower,
 safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses
A complete set of tools, Hydraulic oil if needed, 
 cleaning cloth.
Change the oil after 5 times of an automatic 
 break due to short circuit.
Drain the oil from the CB.
Clean the arc chamber with a new oil.
Refilling the arc chamber with a new oil observe for the oil level.
Lubricate the moving contact of the mechanism operation.
Clean porcelain surfaces.
